pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with sharply defined, angular edges. Individual patches vary in size from small triangular shapes to larger, elongated quadrilaterals.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored interstitial space. Topology is defined by frequent tri-point junction nodes. Path thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the visible neck segment displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized dark, recessed textural disruption is visible on the mid-to-lower flank, suggesting a potential lesion or physical depression in the skin.
